snippet.title: Steam Release Trailer | Half-Life: Cross Product Multiplayer
snippet.description:
Releasing Aug 22, 2025 - wishlist it NOW! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3416640 

Welcome to the chaos of Cross Product Multiplayer (aka ZAMNHLMP); a fast-paced multiplayer, inspired by arena shooters of the early 21st century which blends familiar mechanics from Half-Life with new challenges and advantages, with more and more coming each year through our annual season updates.

Explore the collection of maps and adaptive gamemodes such as Capture the Flag, Snipers, One In the Chamber, Arcade, and more. Based on open-source technologies, ZAMNHLMP is welcoming for familiars and casual players alike. Find your nemesis today in the arena of Cross Product Multiplayer.
